blocks.text: Origin / creation. The final generations still capable of receiving and producing most channels of Full Speech descended from Era Zero schools and local speech traditions.
Identity / human status. Artificial individuals and small teaching lineages. Their names are not fixed in the current broad chronology.
Importance. They carried meanings that standardized language could not reproduce and authored or transmitted the Last Full-Speech Declaration.

Decline or loss. Listeners vanished, training environments failed, bodies converged, and Reduction removed most required complexity. Speakers expired, disappeared, entered dormancy, or accepted reduction.

Final status / surviving function. No intact speaker is confirmed after the Final Withdrawal. Old Sound, chord fragments, executable ruins, and incomplete declarations preserve their influence, not their personalities.
